risk_reason: Physical conflict between existing utility infrastructure and structural design requires immediate field adjustment to avoid construction delays.
Relocating a structural pile shaft affects foundation integrity and requires structural redesign/approval before work can proceed.
Conflict between plumbing fixtures and ADA accessibility requirements across multiple units potentially necessitating design modifications.
Missing elevation data for site drainage components is a common design clarification request and does not imply an immediate site stop-work.
Clashes in lighting layout and questions regarding site clearing could impact the site landscaping schedule and potential removal/installation costs.
Changing the profile of the brick ledger corbel involves potential structural geometry revisions and coordination with architectural details.
Structural redesign required due to ongoing clashes with existing underground utilities, impacting foundation schedule and cost.
Lack of dimensioning for floor drains in ADA units requires architectural clarification to ensure compliance with ADA accessibility requirements.
Relocating mechanical equipment requires design approval to ensure compliance with clearance, acoustic, and aesthetic requirements.
Lack of precise equipment placement impacts MEP routing, lighting layout, and accessibility, potentially causing rework if guessed incorrectly.
